name: When is it better to replace the entire sewer line instead of just repairing a crack?

mainEntity.name: When is it better to replace the entire sewer line instead of just repairing a crack?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between repair and full replacement depends on several factors. If the pipe has multiple cracks, extensive corrosion, sagging, or root intrusion in several sections, replacement might be more cost-effective than continuous repairs. An older pipe that has reached the end of its lifespan or is made of outdated, failure-prone material also warrants replacement. If the current pipe diameter is insufficient for your needs, or if you plan extensive renovations, a full replacement can be a better long-term investment to avoid future issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacement is better for multiple cracks, extensive damage, outdated pipe materials, or if the pipe is nearing the end of its lifespan.
